name: Vocabulary Bot V1

card.note: Compact 1080x675 editorial card: word + type/CEFR + Bangla meaning + short English gloss; no IPA, no Listen label, no pagination.

changes: Photo card now shows Word + Type · CEFR + red-dot divider + Bangla meaning + short English gloss only.
Removed IPA/pronunciation from the photo card.
Removed LISTEN text from the photo card.
Removed pagination markers from the photo card.
Added deterministic POS fallback so the card does not degrade to “Word” when AI is temporarily unavailable.
AI enrichment now retries malformed/incomplete batch output per word, preventing a single JSON failure from blanking the rich post.
Short English gloss is explicitly generated as a 1–3 word visual cue.
Rich example translation remains directly below the English sentence without an extra বাংলা label.
Media cache version bumped to regenerate redesigned cards.
Versioned rich-content cache; degraded AI fallbacks are not reused.
Fail-closed publication when any selected word lacks complete enrichment.
Telegram preflight checks bot identity and channel admin/post permission before queue reservation.
Conservative send retry policy to avoid duplicate posts after unknown network outcomes.
Reuse cached Telegram media without regenerating local card/audio.
Require exact configured fonts in CI publishing environment.
Unknown Telegram transport outcomes are quarantined rather than requeued automatically to prevent duplicate publication.
Card and pronunciation failures block publication when those features are enabled.
AI cache quality gate now requires CEFR and a valid 4-option quiz index.
Single-word AI recovery accepts only the requested word ID.
Corrupt state files now abort the run instead of resetting to fresh state.
HTTP 5xx Telegram responses are treated as unknown outcomes and quarantined to avoid duplicate posts.
Stale reserved items are quarantined rather than automatically requeued; unknown-outcome reservations are never deleted by retention cleanup.
